name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow that routes through separately installed, role-pinned Luna and Terra custom agents and requires a fresh read-only Sol review.

interface.shortDescription: Architect with Sol, implement with role-pinned Luna or Terra, and review with Sol.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex a capability-routed delivery workflow: GPT-5.6 Sol orchestrates, separately installed role-pinned custom agents send routine work to Luna and harder work to Terra, and a fresh read-only Sol reviewer must approve the final diff.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Route this implementation through the appropriate Sol Advisor lane.
Review this deliverable with a fresh Sol advisor before reporting done.
